rubric.clarity: 0 misleading; 1 understandable with prose; 2 relationship evident in the visual

protocol.report: Report gates separately and preserve failed and uninspected outputs. Human preference required, meaning/interaction/layout ratings optional. No agent-assigned human ratings. Record model, commits/source hashes, skill hashes, tools, source and Session IDs. Existing replays are regression evidence, not fresh-generation quality evidence.
